english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a garment worn for swimming, including when the style is not specified.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a swimsuit or swimming costume.
Use this specifically for a swimsuit rather than a costume worn for dressing up.

examples.english: I bought a new swimsuit to go to the beach.
examples.traditional: 我買咗件新泳衣去沙灘。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 wing6 ji1 heoi3 saa1 taan1

examples.english: I forgot to bring my swimming costume to the pool.
Remember to bring a swimming costume; we’re going swimming at the beach later.
examples.traditional: 記住帶泳衣，陣間去沙灘游水。
examples.jyutping: gei3 zyu6 daai3 wing6 ji1 zan6 gaan1 heoi3 saa1 taan1 jau4 seoi2
